title: Probably, Surely, Without Doubt
goal: Rank the adverbs of probability from less sure to more sure and use them with the right mood.

items: I can use seguramente, probablemente and sin duda to say how sure I am.
I can say which adverbs of probability take the indicative and which allow the subjunctive.
I can use the new words for degrees of certainty.
